text:
Hannah (CSM): Heads up 1 CobaltBridge flagged. DAU for /generate and /embed down ~53% WoW. Active seats 47 -> 16. Renewal ~4w. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/metrics/cobaltbridge

Leo (CS Ops): Alerted. Embeddings dropped ~65%, generation down ~48%. p95 latency bumped 700ms -> 1.5s. No 5xxs. Telemetry shows their client reduced concurrency and lowered batch_size last Tuesday.

Priya (AE): Champion Alex moved to another vendor last month, new contact is PM Noor who replied they're running a competitor POC. CFO emailed yesterday asking for unit-cost justification.

Joy (Support): Opening ticket CB-3348; asked Noor for repro samples. Noor replied with one payload and a clip showing mid-sentence cutoffs.

Sam (Product): We rolled a low-cost variant 11 days ago that applies aggressive token trimming and early-stop heuristics on some low-priority routes. If they were auto-routed, truncation + lower token usage fits. I'll check routing snapshot for account cobalt-prod in the affected window.

Hannah (CSM): Customer also reported "inconsistent paraphrases" lately. Could be token trimming or a model switch. Priya, can you lead an exec touch? Propose stabilization offer?

Priya (AE): Yes. I suggest a 30-day Dedicated pilot with throughput credits and a short SLA to stabilize pre-renewal. Will ping Finance/Legal; need quick SOW options.

Leo (CS Ops): Immediate hypotheses: 1) client-side concurrency/batch change reducing observed DAU; 2) variant routing causing truncation; 3) competitor POC political churn. No single 5xx root cause.

Joy (Support): Noor provided sample: ```{"model":"redwood-gen-1.6","prompt":"Summarize Q3 roadmap...","max_tokens":120,"batch":1}``` She said responses cut mid-paragraph. I'll reproduce in sandbox with both variants and SDK versions.

Sam (Product): If CobaltBridge traffic was labeled low_cost.* they'll be on the trimmed variant. I'll confirm and prepare a revert A/B plan (10% traffic to prior variant) if customer permits. That should show full-output % delta quickly.

FinanceBot: @Priya FYI: standard pilot credit cap is 30% for deals < $50k ARR; exceptions need Finance sign-off. Filing approval request now.

Priya (AE): I'll request a 20-min exec sync and surface a stabilization offer today. Also requesting a temporary concurrency bump from the customer to run an A/B 2-hour test.

Leo (CS Ops): Plan: 1) Joy: collect 3 more payloads + reproduce truncation by 4pm; 2) Sam: confirm routing and prepare A/B test plan by tomorrow 10am PT; 3) Priya: exec intro + pilot offer by EOD; 4) Hannah: draft customer-facing note with ROI and short timelines by tomorrow noon.

Joy (Support): Sandbox repro started. Early results: current variant trims at ~115 tokens on that prompt; prior variant yields ~240 tokens. Adding traces to CB-3348.

Sam (Product): Noted. If customer agrees, I can run a 2-hour 10% A/B revert to prior variant and instrument metrics: full_output_pct, p95, tokens_per_call. Expect initial signal in ~30-45m after start.

Priya (AE): Noor replied: "OK to run A/B test and a temporary bump for 2 hours. Exec call after initial results." Scheduling the call.

Hannah (CSM): Great. If A/B shows improved completeness and latency, we push the 30-day Dedicated pilot with credits. Priya, include a one-page SOW template in your outreach to speed legal review.

Leo (CS Ops): Also checking SDK versions: they report client_sdk 2.1.1 which has different retry/backoff semanticsI'll correlate retries with p95 spikes and include that in the note.

Joy (Support): Attaching sandbox snippet to CB-3348: "current variant: '...we will prioritize' (cut)" vs "prior variant: '...we will prioritize onboarding, training, and metrics collection to ensure long-term success.'"

Priya (AE): Looping Finance + Legal now. Will post pilot offer and the proposed SOW draft in this thread once ready.

Hannah (CSM): Owners assigned. Keep updates concise here. If revert proves variant-driven and metrics improve, we fast-track SOW and propose the pilot ahead of renewal. :thumbsup:
